AddToCartRequest.description: POST /v1/cart/items: add or increment a line, the one non-idempotent cart write. `changeId` is required: a UUIDv4 minted once per shopper action and reused by every retry, so a lost response cannot apply twice.

variantId.description: The variant chosen; a product with no options has exactly one.

coverage.description: Who delivers to this address today: decided when read, never saved with it.

defaultDeliveryInstructions.description: The instructions this address prefills at checkout, or null. A placed order never reads this.

ApplyPromoRequest.description: POST /v1/cart/promo: applies a code. Signed-in only (a per-shopper cap needs identity).

ArrivalEstimateDTO.description:
When one package is expected to arrive, as shown at checkout. Not `DeliveryPromiseDTO` (shop-order.ts), which is the shop's ready-by and must never reach a customer.

`promisedFrom`/`promisedTo` are the delivery day (yyyy-mm-dd), equal for a sold window or day; null means the date will be confirmed (never invent one). `windowStart`/`windowEnd` are the window sold, null for an untimed day. Render through `formatArrival`.

method.description: The method the customer chose for this package.

windowStart.description: ISO datetimes with the Australia/Melbourne offset, or null.

BannerTarget.description: Where a promotion tile leads: a closed vocabulary (mobile has no URL router), mapped exhaustively by each client; an unrecognised value renders the tile non-tappable.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2. Always "AU" while Effy sells in one country.

BillingDetailsDTO.description: The billing details Effy supplies at confirmation, so the payment step asks for no country, postcode or name: the order's billing snapshot (the delivery address, or the chosen billing one) and the profile name. Derived, never accepted: a `billingDetails` key in a request is ignored.

BusinessIdentityRequest.description: `PUT /commerce/v1/orders/{id}/business-identity`: the buyer's own business, for its invoice.

CartBlockedReason.description: Why checkout is unavailable, when it is.

CartCheckoutStateDTO.description: Whether the shopper may proceed and, if not, why, so the cart says it up front. The intent enforces it too.

minimumSubtotalAmount.description: Null when no minimum is in force; then nothing is shown.

remainingAmount.description: How much more is needed to reach the minimum. Null unless `blockedReason` is "below_minimum".

CartDTO.description: The full cart, returned by GET /v1/cart and by every mutation, so a client never guesses an outcome.

discount.description: The entered code's line, for the code field. `promotions` lists every promotion applying.

itemSubtotalAmount.description: Payable, available lines only: unavailable items are never charged for.

promotions.description: Every promotion applying, automatic and by code.

promotionsNotApplied.description: Promotions the shopper might expect that do not apply, each with its sentence.

revision.description: Bumped by every mutation; the mirror adopts a response only when this is newer, so a late reply cannot win.

savedLines.description: Set aside for later: kept, shown, and counted in no total.

CartDiscountDTO.description: The discount applying, recomputed on every read; never stored or client-sent.

amount.description: Capped so the payable total never falls below zero.

CartDiscountKind.description: What a discount takes off. Named, so the Kotlin generator emits `CartDiscountKind` rather than `Kind`.

CartLimitsDTO.description: The platform's ceilings, so the client can explain them.

CartLineDTO.description: A cart line, or a set-aside line — the same shape; re-priced against the catalog on every read.

discountAmount.description: What promotions take off this line, in cents as allocated; "0.00" when none.

imageWidths.description: Widths (px) of this picture's smaller copies, ascending; absent or [] means only `imageUrl`. Build each with `renditionUrl`.

packageKey.description: An opaque package grouping key: lines sharing it ship together as one package (one per fulfilling shop). Not a shop id, name or location.

priceChangedFrom.description: The price this line was added at, when it differs from `unitPriceAmount`, so the shopper is told what it was. Null when unchanged. The shopper always pays `unitPriceAmount`.

unitPrice.description: The comparison price of one unit after this line's discount; null without a pack size.

variantId.description: The variant this line buys; lines are keyed by it (two sizes of one product are two lines).

variantLabel.description: "Spiced / 500 g"; null for a product with no options.

CartLineInput.description: One line of a client-supplied set (merge, preview).

detail.description: The sentence to show, composed server-side.
Specifics where the kind alone is not enough. Never names or implies a shop.

variantId.description: The line's variant, when the notice is about a line.

CartNoticeKind.description: A notice shown before checkout. `productId` is null for a cart-level notice (a code that stopped applying).

CartPolicyDTO.description: GET /v1/cart/policy (public): the minimum and the ceilings, for a guest cart.

CartPreviewRequest.description: POST /v1/cart/preview (public): re-prices a guest's device cart with notices and writes nothing.

CartPromotionLineDTO.description: A promotion applying to this cart, and what it takes off.

code.description: The code the shopper entered for it; null for an automatic promotion.

deliveryAmount.description: Known once a delivery quote exists (checkout); "0.00" in the cart.

headline.description: The shopper's words (the headline, or the offer label when there is none).

CartPromotionNotAppliedReason.description: Why a promotion the shopper could expect does not apply. Named for the Kotlin generator.

CheckoutPointsDTO.description: What a customer can spend at checkout, on the quote; absent with no points. Offer up to min(usable, total); the card part must be 0 or at least `cardMinimumAmount`.

ConfirmCheckoutRequest.description: POST /v1/checkout/confirm: the fallback finalizer for a delayed or missed webhook.

CourierQuoteDTO.description: What a customer is told and charged when a courier delivers the order.

estimate.description: The courier's usual timeframe in the business's words ("2–4 business days"); always printed through `courierLines`.

fee.description: The courier fee for the whole order: lines and a total.

reason.description: `out_of_coverage`: Effy does not deliver there. `no_window`: it does, but no window is available and the business sends it by courier; the client says there are no windows first.

CourierQuoteReason.description: Why a courier delivers this order. Named, so the generated Kotlin enum is too.

CoverageKind.description: Who delivers to an address:   effy     the postcode is on Effy's list; Effy's drivers deliver   courier  not on the list, and courier delivery is offered there   none     neither reaches it Decided only by `public.coverage_for_postcode`, when asked, never stored against an address. A customer contract carries this value and nothing about why.

CreateAddressRequest.description: POST /v1/addresses — the first address created becomes the default.

defaultDeliveryInstructions.description: On update the key's presence is read: absent leaves the default, `null` clears it, a value replaces it.

CreateCheckoutIntentRequest.description: POST /v1/checkout/intent: create or locate the pending order and its PaymentIntent.

addressId.description: The shipping address (required), snapshotted onto the order.

billingAddressId.description: The billing address, when it differs; absent, null or equal to `addressId` means same as shipping. Never affects the amount.

deliveryInstructions.description: What the customer tells the driver for this order, or null. Normalised by the server with the client's own rule (`normaliseDeliveryInstructions`); refused with a field error, never truncated. The server stores what this request carries and never reads the address's saved default.

deliveryPromise.description: "As soon as possible", sent instead of `deliveryWindow` when the quote carried `effyWindows.asap`; both or neither is `slot_required`. A day with no time is `deliveryWindow` naming its `anyTime`.

deliveryType.description: The delivery type the client is showing; required for a courier order. A mismatch with what applies now (or a courier quote answered without it) is 409 `delivery_type_changed` with a fresh quote.

deliveryWindow.description: The window chosen, one for the whole order. Required when the quote carried `effyWindows` (else `slot_required`). The server holds a place when it accepts it (`slotHeldUntil`).

expectedDiscount.description: The promotions total (goods + delivery) the client is showing. A different server total is 409 `promotions_changed` with the current cart, nothing written.

pointsToUse.description: Points to pay with (whole, absent = 0). Refused rather than clamped: over usable is 409 `points_balance_changed`, over the total 422 `points_exceed_total`, a card remainder under the provider minimum 422 `points_card_remainder_too_small`; each says what is possible.

shownDeliveryAmount.description: The delivery total the client is showing. A different server total is 409 `delivery_fee_changed` with a fresh quote, nothing written, so the customer sees it before paying.

wantsProviderMethodList.description: Set by a client rendering a provider-owned payment-method list (mobile), which needs a customer session; always minted for the authenticated subject. There is no `billingDetails` here: they derive from the order's snapshot.

billingDetails.description: The billing details the client passes back at confirmation, derived from the order (the confirmed delivery or billing address, plus the profile name), never from the request.

clientSecret.description: Authorizes confirming exactly this PaymentIntent. Never a secret key.

customerId.description: The provider customer the session belongs to, present only beside `customerSessionSecret` (the mobile SDKs take both). The secret is the credential; this id alone reaches no API. Never logged or accepted as input.

customerSessionSecret.description: Authorizes a provider-owned payment-method list for this shopper. Mobile only (the web lists cards from `GET /v1/payment-methods`); null elsewhere.

deliveryDiscountAmount.description: What delivery promotions took off the fee; absent or "0.00" when none.

deliveryFee.description: The delivery charge inside `grandTotalAmount`, as lines.

deliveryType.description: The delivery type the order was written with.

paidWithPoints.description: True when points covered the whole order: already paid, `clientSecret` empty; go to the confirmation.

payOverTimeAvailable.description: Whether the provider offers an instalment option for this intent, as the provider answers it.

pointsUsed.description: The points this order uses, their value, and what is left for the card.

slotHeldUntil.description: Until when the window place is held. Once passed, call intent again before confirming payment: it is the last moment the server can say the place has gone.

CreateRefundRequestBody.description: No destination field, ever: the refund goes to the order's payment method.

CustomerCompensationDTO.description: What a customer received when their order was moved to courier; null when nothing was given.

CustomerRefundDTO.description: One refund as the customer sees it: three states, no failure text.

DeliveryChoiceRefusalCode.description: Why an intent was refused over the delivery choice: the `code` of a 409, with a fresh `quote`. A refusal never substitutes a window or a day; the customer chooses again.

DeliveryChoiceRefusalDTO.description: The body of a delivery-choice refusal.

quote.description: The options as they stand now. Absent on `slot_required` when no slot was sent.

DeliveryFeeDTO.description: What a customer is charged, in lines summing exactly to `totalAmount`; zero lines are omitted. Nothing else: no distance, band, weight or plan, so nobody can work out where the hub is or how pricing works.

promotionAmount.description: What this shopper's delivery promotions take off this option's fee. `totalAmount` is unchanged; the promotions total is compared separately.

DeliveryFeeLineDTO.description: `amount` is a signed 2-dp decimal string; only `free_delivery` is negative.

DeliveryFeeLineKind.description: One line of what a customer is charged for delivery:   delivery          the fee for distance and weight, before any window surcharge   window_surcharge  what the chosen window adds   small_order       the extra fee under the small-order amount   free_delivery     the saving at the free-delivery amount (negative)

note.description: Plain text, already normalised; never interpreted as markup.

DeliveryMethod.description: The customer's words for when an Effy order arrives: `same_day` (a window today) or `standard` (a later day). No price of its own.

DeliveryNoteDTO.description: `GET /commerce/v1/orders/{id}/delivery-note` — what was supplied, line by line.

deliveredAt.description: When the last of the order arrived.

lines.description: Merged by product across packages, so nothing reveals how many suppliers filled it.

DeliveryNoteLineDTO.description: One line of the delivery note: a product, merged across the order's packages.

DeliveryPromise.description: What an Effy order was sold: a time on a day, a day with no time, or "as soon as possible".

DeliveryQuoteDTO.description: The delivery quote shown at checkout, captured server-side so the order is honoured at it (the client never sends a fee). A serviced address answers `effyWindows` or `courier`. No package list.

courier.description: PRESENT EXACTLY WHEN `coverage` is `"courier"`: nothing to choose; show "Courier delivery", the estimate and the fee, and send `deliveryType: "courier"`. No distance, company or supplier count.

coverage.description: Who delivers to this address. `none` means not serviced; `courier` only when a courier order can be placed.

effyWindows.description: PRESENT EXACTLY WHEN `coverage` is `"effy"`: today's windows ("Same-day delivery") and later days' ("Standard delivery"). The choice goes back as `deliveryWindow`.

expiresAt.description: ISO datetime with the Australia/Melbourne offset; "" when not serviced.

freeDeliveryRemainingAmount.description: How much more the basket needs for free delivery; null when there is no such amount or it is reached.

points.description: The customer's spendable points, when they have any.

DeliveryType.description: Who delivers an order. One per order, whatever number of suppliers fill it.

estimate.description: The business's words, e.g. "usually within 2–3 days". Print it only as an estimate.

fee.description: Never carries a window or a delivery-today surcharge.

EffyDayClosedReason.description: Why a day has no window to choose. A later day is only ever "full".

EffyDayDTO.description: One day on offer: today (`same_day`) or a later delivery day (`standard`).

anyTime.description: This day sold with no time, sent back as `deliveryWindow`; the order is promised the day. Always null for today, never in `windows`.

closedReason.description: Why `windows` is empty; null when it is not.

EffyWindowDTO.description: One window on one day. No capacity or remaining count: a full window is absent.

cutoffAt.description: After this the window can no longer be chosen.

fee.description: The order's delivery charge with this window chosen.

slotId.description: Opaque. Sent back with `date` as `deliveryWindow` on the intent request.

startAt.description: ISO datetimes with the Australia/Melbourne offset.

surchargeAmount.description: What this window adds over the plain later-day fee; "0.00" when nothing.

asap.description: "As soon as possible", when some day can take an untimed order. Carries no day; chosen with `deliveryPromise: "asap"`.

days.description: Today first, then the next delivery days. Never empty.

unavailable.description: Set when no window is open on any day: `no_windows` (closed or taken) or `none_defined` (none switched on).

FacetDTO.description: One refinable dimension: category, brand, an attribute key, or `offers`.

FacetOptionDTO.description: One value within a facet, with its count in the current result set. Zero-count options are omitted, so `count` is ≥ 1.

count.description: `WireInt`, so the generated Kotlin reads an Int.

FacetSetDTO.description: The facets for a query and its filters, with per-option counts. Computed on filter change, not per page; `priceBounds` is null for an empty set.

FacetType.description: The control a facet drives: `single_select` pick one (category; reuses the `categoryKey` filter). `multi_select`  tick many, OR within (brand, select and boolean attributes). `toggle`        on/off (offers). A client meeting an unknown value renders nothing for that facet.

HandoverPreference.description: Delivery instructions: how to hand the order over, and a short note. The vocabulary, the length limit and the normalisation rule live here only; the customer surfaces use them for a remaining-characters count and checkout calls `normaliseDeliveryInstructions` itself, so client and server agree. `delivery-instructions.fixtures.json` is the rule's table of cases.

paymentMethods.description: Empty means no kept cards and nothing else; a provider outage is an error, never `[]`.

MediaDTO.description: A product image: its permanent public address and alt text.

imageWidths.description: Widths (px) of this picture's smaller copies, ascending; absent or [] means only `imageUrl`. Build each with `renditionUrl`.

MergeCartRequest.description: POST /v1/cart/merge: folds a device cart into the account cart at sign-in, taking the maximum quantity per variant, so a repeat or retried merge leaves the same cart. Nothing from either side is dropped.

OptionValueIds.description: `[position-1 value, position-2 value]`; null where the product has no such option.

OrderAddressDTO.description: The snapshotted delivery address on the receipt.

amountPaidAfterRefunds.description: What the shopper is out of pocket after refunds. Not a correction to `grandTotalAmount`, which is what was charged: a receipt must reconcile against a bank statement.

arrivalEstimates.description: When the order is expected to arrive. Carries no shop reference. Empty for a courier order, which has no window or day: read `delivery` and print `deliverySummary`.

billingAddress.description: The billing address snapshot; `null` means same as shipping. Never exposed to a shop.

cancellable.description: May the shopper still cancel this order themselves? Server-derived and advisory: the server decides again under a row lock. `false` does not mean it can never be cancelled (staff can, before it leaves), so wording must leave that door open.

delivery.description: Who delivers the order, and for a courier the estimate sold; printed through `deliverySummary`.

deliveryAddress.description: The shipping address snapshot, where the order is delivered.

deliveryDiscountAmount.description: What delivery promotions took off the fee.

deliveryFee.description: The same charge as lines (delivery, window surcharge, small-order fee, free delivery), as sold and never recomputed.

deliveryInstructions.description: What the customer told the driver, or null. Fixed once paid. Render nothing for null, and `note` as plain text.

discountAmount.description: The promotional discount as computed at payment and stored, so the receipt stays explainable after a promotion changes. "0.00" when none.

fullyRefunded.description: Derived from the totals, never stored, so line-by-line and all-at-once reach the same fact.

paymentMethod.description: How the order was paid, safe to display; null when the post-commit capture failed (the receipt omits the line).

paymentSplit.description: How the order was paid when points were part of it, and what has come back. Absent with no points; points are a way of paying, never a discount.

promoCode.description: The code used, kept beside the discount so the receipt can still say "SPRING20"; null when none.

promotions.description: Each promotion applied and what it took off.

refundedTotal.description: What has been returned or is on its way. Absent with no refunds.

refunds.description: Every refund on this order, newest first. Absent entirely (not an empty array) when nothing was refunded. No failure reason, kind or provider reference (see [CustomerRefundDTO]).

stage.description: The customer-facing progress stage, always server-derived (never computed from `fulfillments`). A rollup, not a max: a two-shop order with one portion delivered and one being picked is `packing`.

OrderDeliveryDTO.description: An order's delivery, as a customer contract carries it.

courierEstimate.description: The courier's usual timeframe as it was sold ("2–4 business days"); null for an Effy order.

moved.description: Present only after back-office moved the order to the other type: the latest move and what the customer received. Never the reason, the courier fee, the difference or Effy's cost.

promise.description: Absent on a courier order. `day`: the arrival has the day and no hours. `asap`: no arrival, only `asapEstimate`.

tracking.description: How the customer follows a courier order: `link` (one consignment with a tracking link) or `email` (several, each tracking emailed). Absent otherwise. Never a count or anything per parcel.

OrderDeliveryMoveDTO.description: The latest move of an order's delivery type by back-office, as the customer reads it.

OrderFulfillmentDTO.description: An anonymous fulfilment portion: no shop name, id, or anything implying who fulfils it.

unavailableItems.description: Present only once the portion is terminal; absent while picking.

OrderItemDTO.description: A line on the receipt: a product snapshot, never a shop.

discountAmount.description: What promotions took off this line, as sold. Absent or "0.00" when none.

imageUrl.description: A short-lived presigned URL for the product's primary image, or null. Decoration only: a line is complete without it. It comes from the live catalogue; every other field is the order's snapshot, so a renamed product still shows what was bought.

imageWidths.description: Widths (px) of this picture's smaller copies, ascending; absent or [] means only `imageUrl`. Build each with `renditionUrl`.

orderItemId.description: This line's own id. Not interchangeable with `productId`: two lines of one product cannot be told apart by product id, and a refund request naming a product would silently match nothing. Discloses nothing about fulfilment.

variantLabel.description: The variant's label as sold ("Spiced / 500 g"); null for a product with no options.

OrderPaymentSplitDTO.description: How an order was paid and what has come back, on customer and staff order reads.

OrderPromotionDTO.description: One promotion applied to an order, as sold (never re-derived).

OrderShortfallDTO.description: An item the customer paid for and will not receive, disclosed only once the portion is terminal (a flag raised and undone mid-pick never reaches the customer). Carries no refund promise.

OrderStage.description: The customer-facing progress vocabulary: a closed union rolled up server-side from every `shop_fulfillment.status` (`stageFor` in `apis/edge-api/shared/src/lib/order-completion.ts`).

OrderStatus.description: Order lifecycle mirrored to the client (payment-driven).

OrderSummaryDTO.description: A row in the order history (GET /v1/orders).

arrivalEstimates.description: The promise the order was sold, as on the receipt. Absent for a courier order.

deliveredAt.description: When the whole order had arrived (ISO); only once `stage` is `delivered`.

fullyRefunded.description: The whole amount has gone back.

promoCode.description: Set when a promotional code was used, so history can mark a discounted order.

refundedTotal.description: What has gone back to the customer so far. Absent when nothing has.

stage.description: The one word for where a PAID order is. Absent on an unpaid, failed or cancelled order.

thumbnailWidths.description: Index-aligned with `thumbnails`: each one's smaller copies (see `imageWidths`).

thumbnails.description: The primary picture of the order's first few lines (at most four), for the order list: short-lived presigned URLs from the live catalogue; `null` where a line has none. Never a shop, a package, or a supplier count.

PaymentMethodDTO.description: A card the shopper chose to keep, read live from the provider when needed and never persisted (a copy would go stale).

brand.description: Network, for the mark and the label (e.g. "visa", "mastercard", "amex").

expMonth.description: `WireInt`, so the generated Kotlin is an `Int`.

isDefault.description: Which card the payment step pre-selects.

last4.description: The ONLY part of a card number that may leave the provider.

unusableReason.description: Why the card cannot be used, when it cannot.

usable.description: Server-computed: the client never infers it from the expiry.

PaymentMethodSummaryDTO.description: How an order was paid, safe to show. No card data beyond `last4`, ever.

brand.description: Network or wallet for the label ("visa", "apple_pay"). Null when the family carries no brand.

last4.description: The only part of a card number allowed to leave the provider; null for non-card families.

type.description: Effy's own family, never the provider's string.

PaymentStatus.description: Payment outcome mirrored from the Stripe PaymentIntent.

ProductAttributeGroupDTO.description: A labelled group of attribute rows on the product detail page (never laid out as cards).

ProductBadge.description: A badge on a product card, derived server-side (on_sale = has compare-at; new = newest).

ProductOfferDTO.description: A product's offer badge on listings and its page.

ProductSearchResultDTO.description: A page of results with a keyset cursor. `cursor` is opaque and sort-tagged: one from another ordering is 400 `cursor_sort_mismatch`.

sort.description: The ordering actually applied (may differ from the request): render the sort control from this.

total.description: Total products matching the refinements, ignoring pagination.

ProductSort.description: How a result set can be ordered. `relevance` needs a text query; without one the server uses `newest` and says so in `ProductSearchResultDTO.sort`.

PromotionDTO.description: One promotion in full, the destination of a tap (`GET /storefront/v1/promotions/{id}`). Served through the same visibility rule as Home, so one that ended meanwhile is 404, not stale terms (hence uncached).

code.description: NON-nullable: a screen whose purpose is to hand over a code must have one.

imageWidths.description: Widths (px) of this picture's smaller copies, ascending; absent or [] means only `imageUrl`. Build each with `renditionUrl`.

terms.description: The terms sentence, from the server-side composer.

validity.description: How long is left ("Ends in 3 days"), composed server-side; null when it never ends.

PromotionKind.description: Promotions: an offer of one of four kinds, applied automatically or by code, limited by who, when and how much, and shown in display groups the clients ask for by key. Its state is never stored (`public.promotion_state`). One evaluator: `@effy/edge-shared/promotions` (engine.ts).

RefundRequestDTO.description: A customer's ask: no amount, no provider reference, no money moved. One statement, one outcome, not a thread.

ReorderRequest.description: POST /v1/cart/reorder: puts a past order's items back, taking the maximum against the current cart.

ReorderResultDTO.description: The reorder outcome: the cart plus exactly what could not come back. Names no shop.

ReorderSkipReason.description: Why an item from a past order could not be added back.

variantLabel.description: The label it was sold with.

SaveItemRequest.description: PUT /commerce/v1/saved/{productId}: save (idempotent). `variantId` remembers the selected variant; saving again updates it.

SavedAddToCartResultDTO.description: The result of adding every purchasable saved item to the cart. Every omission is in `skipped`, with a reason.

SavedItemDTO.description: One entry in the saved list. Name, image and current price are read live; only `savedPriceAmount` is remembered, so a drop is detectable. It does not extend `StorefrontProductCardDTO`: that card's `available` flag is catalogue status only, and `verdict` replaces it, so the card fields are repeated.

categoryKey.description: For grouping by aisle; absent when the product has no primary category.

imageWidths.description: Widths (px) of this picture's smaller copies, ascending; absent or [] means only `imageUrl`. Build each with `renditionUrl`.

priceDropped.description: Present and `true` only when the current price is below the save-time price. No `priceRose`: a rise is not actionable.

savedAt.description: When it was saved: list order (newest first) and undo's restore position.

savedPriceAmount.description: The price when saved: the baseline for `priceDropped`.

variantCount.description: More than one active variant: adding without a remembered one asks the shopper to choose.

variantId.description: The variant "Add to cart" adds: the one remembered when saved, else the product's only one. Null when there are several sizes and none is remembered (or it is no longer sold): the shopper chooses. Price, verdict and image are the remembered variant's when there is one.

variantLabel.description: Its label ("1 kg"); null when none, or with no options.

productId.description: Place this product in the new list in the same action.

SavedListDTO.description: One of the shopper's lists. `name` is `null` for the default list ("Saved" is each client's display text).

containsProduct.description: Present only when the read named a product: whether this list holds it.

id.description: A uuid, or `"default"` for the default list.

onlyHereCount.description: How many of this list's products are in no other list: deleting it unsaves them, and the confirmation says so.

restoreAddedAt.description: Set only by undo, to return the product to its position in this list.

variantId.description: The variant the shopper had selected; it becomes the remembered one.

SavedListRefusal.description: Why the platform refused a list request. A closed set; clients switch on these and nothing else. Carried as the last path segment of the problem's `type`, with `_` written as `-`.

SavedMembershipDTO.description: The shopper's whole set of saved product ids, fetched once per screen and answering for every product on it (catalogue reads stay shopper-neutral). The 200-item cap keeps it cheap.

namedProductIds.description: The ids also held in a named list. A tap on a filled heart un-saves a product only in "Saved"; one in a named list opens the list chooser (the platform refuses the removal with 409 anyway).

SavedMergeItem.description: One device-held saved item offered to an account.

savedPriceAmount.description: The guest's save-time price travels with it, so the watchlist keeps the movement. Absent means the device never saw a price: the platform then uses the current price, as an ordinary save does (never send "0").

variantId.description: The variant the device remembered, if any.

SavedMergeResultDTO.description: The result of joining a device-held list into an account: the resulting set (so the client seeds its store from it) and `added`, so the surface discloses the join by count.

SavedSkip.description: Why one product could not be taken (a merge or a bulk add).

reason.description: `cap_reached` | `not_found` | a `SavedVerdict` | a cart refusal reason | `choose_variant` (open the product and choose).

SavedVerdict.description: Whether the shopper can buy a saved item now, each value implying a next action:   purchasable             → buy now   temporarily_unavailable → sold, not in stock: wait   no_longer_sold          → withdrawn: give up

ShopperPromotionDTO.description: One promotion as both customer clients show it, from either group read.

code.description: The shared code; null for an automatic promotion or one with single-use codes only.

skin.description: How this promotion looks in this place. A client that does not know `skin.layout` draws its built-in look, as for `classic`.

terms.description: The conditions sentence, composed server-side ("On orders over $30.00 · Effy delivery only").

ShopperSkinDTO.description: The skin a placement wears, with the picture it shows.

size.description: The size of the place the group fills.

focusX.description: 0–1 from the left / top: the point every crop keeps in view.

imageWidths.description: Widths of the WebP copies; build each with `renditionUrl`.

picture.description: Show the promotion's picture. Required layouts (`full_picture`, `picture_beside`) always do.

tint.description: Laid over the picture under the words. Strength 0–0.9.

SkinSettings.description: The settings of a designed skin. Layout-only fields are present on their layout alone.

body.description: `header_card`: the body under the header, and the colour of its "Code"/"Offer" tag.

dark.description: The customer app's dark appearance. Absent → the skin looks the same in both.

pictureSide.description: `picture_beside`: which side the picture is on, and how it fills its half.

StorefrontCategoryDTO.description: A browse category, customer projection (GET /storefront/v1/categories); unlike catalog.ts's `CategoryDTO` it carries no internal id, status or order.

imageUrl.description: A representative image derived from a product in the category (categories store none), chosen deterministically; null renders a brand tile.

imageWidths.description: Widths (px) of this picture's smaller copies, ascending; absent or [] means only `imageUrl`. Build each with `renditionUrl`.

productCount.description: Purchasable products in this category and everything under it, so an aisle's number is what its page shows.

StorefrontProductCardDTO.description: The product card used in rails, search results, saved items and recently viewed.

available.description: Some variant can be bought now (the one availability rule).

compareAtAmount.description: The "was" price of the variant `priceAmount` came from.

imageWidths.description: Widths (px) of this picture's smaller copies, ascending; absent or [] means only `imageUrl`. Build each with `renditionUrl`.

offer.description: An item or buy-X-get-Y promotion open to everyone that covers this product.

priceAmount.description: The listing price: the lowest among active variants (say "From" when `priceVaries`). Selling out one size never moves it.

unitPrice.description: The comparison price of `priceAmount`, with a unit basis and a pack size.

variantCount.description: Active variants; above 1 the tile offers "Choose" instead of quick-add.

variantId.description: The variant this tile stands for (the one a stock-code or barcode search matched, else the default); quick-add adds it when `variantCount` is 1.

StorefrontProductDetailDTO.description: Full product detail (gallery, description, grouped attributes, category path).

available.description: Some variant can be bought now (the one availability rule).

categoryKey.description: The primary category's key, for the related-products rail (`categoryPath` carries display names, which cannot be queried).

compareAtAmount.description: The "was" price of the variant `priceAmount` came from.

defaultVariantId.description: The variant to open on: the one the link named if active, else the first that can be bought, else the first.

imageWidths.description: Widths (px) of this picture's smaller copies, ascending; absent or [] means only `imageUrl`. Build each with `renditionUrl`.

offer.description: An item or buy-X-get-Y promotion open to everyone that covers this product.

options.description: The product's options in the shop's order; empty when none (no selector).

unitPrice.description: The comparison price of `priceAmount`, with a unit basis and a pack size.

variantId.description: The variant this tile stands for (the one a stock-code or barcode search matched, else the default); quick-add adds it when `variantCount` is 1.

variants.description: Active variants only, in display order.

StorefrontRailDTO.description: A merchandising rail on Home (Featured / On-sale / a category rail).

StorefrontVariantDTO.description: A shopper's view of one variant. Inactive and removed variants are never sent to shoppers.

imageUrl.description: The variant's own picture, or null — show the product's gallery.

imageWidths.description: Widths (px) of this picture's smaller copies, ascending.

label.description: "Spiced / 500 g"; null when the product has no options.

TaxDocumentDTO.description: A tax invoice or adjustment note exactly as issued: the frozen snapshot the PDF renders. Money is a decimal string; it never changes.

buyer.description: The buyer's identity, printed at $1,000 or more; null below it.

UnitBasis.description:
Unit pricing. A product says how its sizes are compared (`UnitBasis`: per 100 g, per kg, per 100 mL, per L, each); each variant says how much is in its pack. The comparison price is the price scaled to the basis ($3.20 for 500 g → $0.64 / 100 g), as the Unit Pricing Code asks.

One sum, here: the server computes `UnitPriceDTO`; clients only format it (`unitPriceText`), the app's Kotlin formatter pinned to `unit-price.fixtures.json`. Integer arithmetic: whole cents, quantities in thousandths, one half-up rounding at the end.

UnitPriceDTO.description: A server-computed comparison price. `amount` is a 2-dp money string, like every price on the wire.

defaultDeliveryInstructions.description: On update the key's presence is read: absent leaves the default, `null` clears it, a value replaces it.

UpdateCartLineRequest.description: PATCH /v1/cart/items/{variantId}: sets an absolute quantity (0 removes), so the client can debounce taps safely. Idempotent; `changeId` is optional.

WireInt.description: A whole number on the wire. A plain `number` becomes a Kotlin `Double` and sends `1.0`; this makes the schema say `"integer"` (a Kotlin `Long`). Use it for every count, quantity, limit and revision.

promotionGroups.description: Display groups by key (storefront public, commerce personal).
